name: Deborah Ross
page_title: Deborah Ross' Issue Positions (Political Courage Test)
on_the_ballot: Running, Democratic for U.S. House (NC) - District 2

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "One year ago today, the Supreme Court upended decades of legal precedent & overturned Roe v Wade. Make no mistake: abortion bans are a threat to women, doctors, and our health care. Today, I’m more committed than ever & promise to always fight for reproductive freedom."

"Today, on the anniversary of Roe v. Wade, I hosted a roundtable with leaders and health care providers to discuss the future of abortion access. Today & every day, I'm committed to protecting reproductive health care in NC & beyond."
Rated 100% by Planned Parenthood Action Fund
Voted in favor of HR 3755 "Women's Health Protection Act of 2021."

positions.question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support social safety net programs such as Social Security and Medicare?

evidence.text: "Every American should be able to enjoy a comfortable and secure retirement. Our seniors have paid into Social Security and Medicare over a lifetime of hard work, and I won’t stop fighting to protect these earned benefits. In Congress, I’m working to strengthen Social Security and will strenuously oppose any attempt to turn Medicare into a voucher program. I also support lowering the Medicare eligibility age from 65 to 60."

"Our seniors have earned Social Security and Medicare over their lifetime of hard work, and I will work to protect the economic security so many North Carolinians depend on. In Congress, I'll prioritize strengthening Social Security and will fight any attempt to turn Medicare into a voucher program. The next generation has many competing financial obligations and will benefit from stabilizing Medicare and Social Security. Tax cuts skewed to millionaires irresponsibly increases the deficit at a time when we need investments in retirement security for our seniors, health care, education, and infrastructure. I'll pursue a responsible budget in Congress that meets the needs of North Carolinians of every age and helps ensure a secure retirement for us all."
Rated 100% by National Committee to Preserve Social Security and Medicare
Voted in favor of S 610 "Protecting Medicare and American Farmers from Sequester Cuts Act."

positions.question: Do you support the regulation of indirect campaign contributions from corporations, unions, and individuals?

evidence.text: "Today, I was proud to vote for H.R.1 -- a transformative package to make elections fairer and voting accessible," saidCongresswoman Ross. "Election reform isn't about political parties, it's about voters and ensuring their voices are heard. In North Carolina, I have seen firsthand the effects of the many reforms we implemented to make voting easier. Because of these reforms, we saw record voter turnout in the state in 2020. The For the People Act builds on this progress by protecting the right to vote, ensuring the integrity of our elections, holding elected officials accountable, and ending the rule of special interests."
Rated 100% by Common Cause
Voted in favor of HR 1 "For the People Act of 2021."

positions.question: Do you support protecting government officials, including law enforcement officers, from personal liability in civil lawsuits concerning alleged misconduct?

evidence.text: "I have spent my career fighting for equality, justice, and progress. I care deeply about our community and have worked to document police misconduct in racial profiling, and prosecutorial misconduct through the Racial Justice Act. I worked to pass the South's first anti-racial profiling bill, fought to reform juvenile justice programs, and opposed laws that would take our state backward. Along with our community leaders, I have fought for policies that dismantle discrimination everywhere injustice is found. But there is so much work to be done. In Congress, I will continue to fight for justice and the rights of all people. I will continue to push for economic security and social mobility for all people. I will work with anyone and everyone to create meaningful legislation that gets to the root of systemic racial injustice in this country."
"Today we remember George Floyd - we mourn for his family, friends, and the community. One year after his death, we still have work to do to combat systemic racism and police violence."
Voted in favor of HR 1280 "George Floyd Justice in Policing Act of 2021."

positions.question: Do you support increasing defense spending?

evidence.text: Voted in favor of HR 2670: "National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024"
Voted in favor of HR 7900: "National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2023"
Voted in favor of S 1605: "National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2022"

positions.question: Do you support federal spending as a means of promoting economic growth (e.g. grants, tax incentives)?

evidence.text: "I voted to pass the historic Build Back Better Act to improve access to life-saving medical care; deliver affordable health care, child care, and home care; expand affordable housing and education; and launch the most significant effort to combat the climate crisis in American history. With this legislation, we are making long overdue investments in our people for generations to come – investments in our children, parents, and grandparents."

"The House just passed the #AmericaCOMPETESAct! This historic package will support the innovation happening in the Research Triangle & all across America. Included in the package are several of my bills & amendments to support a diverse STEM workforce, clean energy tech & more."

"When I first started as an attorney, I specialized in municipal bond law to help local governments fund critical infrastructure and public work programs. I went on to work for our regional transit agency with a mission of improving public transportation options. In Congress, I am working to drive investment in transportation and infrastructure projects and increase renewable energy options in pursuit of a more carbon-free future. I proudly voted to pass the bipartisan Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act, a transformational law that will upgrade the nation’s aging infrastructure and create good-paying jobs in North Carolina."
Voted in favor of HR 5376 "Inflation Reduction Act of 2022"

positions.question: Do you support the federal government increasing funding for affordable housing programs?

evidence.text: "I voted to pass the historic Build Back Better Act to improve access to life-saving medical care; deliver affordable health care, child care, and home care; expand affordable housing and education; and launch the most significant effort to combat the climate crisis in American history. With this legislation, we are making long overdue investments in our people for generations to come – investments in our children, parents, and grandparents."

"I’m thrilled to announce the 10 community projects that I requested funding for were included in House appropriations bills. That’s $10.6 million in federal investments for education, affordable housing, and transit projects for the people of NC's 2nd District."

"The billions of dollars the #AmericansJobsPlan will put towards roads and bridges, public transportation, broadband accessibility, schools, housing and energy needs will have a substantial impact on our communities for years to come."

"Today, we came together to pass critical government funding, including over $26 million for projects in Wake County. From investing in affordable housing & health care to improving quality education & public safety, this package puts us on track for a better & brighter future."

positions.question: Do you support the federal government taking action, beyond those of the Federal Reserve, to alleviate inflation?

evidence.text: "It's critical that we invest in clean energy development to combat the climate crisis and build a more sustainable future. I fought to pass the Inflation Reduction Act to do just that and invest in our future."

"One year ago today, the historic Inflation Reduction Act was signed into law. From implementing clean energy tax credits to capping the costs of insulin for Medicare recipients, the IRA has already been delivering for North Carolinians."
"The Inflation Reduction Act was an historic piece of legislation that is already delivering for our state & saving North Carolinians money."
Voted in favor of HR 5376 "Inflation Reduction Act of 2022"

positions.question: Do you support the forgiveness of federal student loan debt?

evidence.text: "Today @POTUS announced another extension on the pause on student loan payments. This is an important step as we work to relieve to student borrowers, but we can't stop there. We must act to make education more affordable and ensure the next generation can pursue their dreams."

"Today's SCOTUS decision is a disappointing setback for millions of borrowers who are burdened by student loan debt. This ruling only underscores that we must do more to make college more affordable and ensure anyone can access the American dream."
Rated 100% by National Education Association

positions.question: Do you support requiring a government-issued identification in order to vote at the polls?

evidence.text: "I also voted to pass the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act, crucial legislation to restore the fundamental guarantees of the Voting Rights Act and prevent discriminatory voting practices, like racial gerrymandering and restrictive voter ID laws."

"The right to vote is a cornerstone of our democracy. It’s imperative that we work to strengthen voting rights – not make it more difficult for North Carolinians to cast a ballot. That’s why I voted for and cosponsored the For the People Act, a sweeping package to protect and expand voting rights, restore integrity in government, and put the needs of the American people ahead of the priorities of powerful special interests."
Rated 100% by Common Cause

positions.question: Do you support government funding for the development of renewable energy (e.g. solar, wind, geo-thermal)?

evidence.text: "Climate change is an imminent threat to our country and our planet, and we must take immediate action to address it. As a state legislator, I voted to support clean energy alternatives, halt fracking, and implement measures to reduce emissions in North Carolina. In Congress, I was proud to vote to pass the Build Back Better Act, in part because it represents an unprecedented effort to combat the climate crisis. This transformational legislation will reduce carbon pollution, bolster community resilience, and strengthen the American clean energy economy."

"I am an original cosponsor of the Defend Our Coast Act, which will protect the coasts of North Carolina from being leased for exploration, development, and production of oil or gas. I also cosponsored the Arctic Refuge Protection Act, a bill to permanently protect the Coastal Plain of the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge from oil and gas drilling."

"I led a bipartisan effort to urge the Bureau of Ocean Energy Management to lease offshore wind energy areas off the coast of North Carolina. Our state is particularly well-positioned to meaningfully contribute to the offshore wind industry, ranking first among east coast states in both technical potential for offshore wind generation capacity and manufacturing workforce. I continue to push for passage of the Restoring Offshore Wind Opportunities Act to overturn former President Trump’s 10-year moratorium on offshore wind energy leasing off our coast, set to take effect in 2022."

"When I first started as an attorney, I specialized in municipal bond law to help local governments fund critical infrastructure and public work programs. I went on to work for our regional transit agency with a mission of improving public transportation options. In Congress, I am working to drive investment in transportation and infrastructure projects and increase renewable energy options in pursuit of a more carbon-free future. I proudly voted to pass the bipartisan Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act, a transformational law that will upgrade the nation’s aging infrastructure and create good-paying jobs in North Carolina."

positions.question: Do you support the federal government allowing permits for drilling on public lands?

evidence.text: "I am an original cosponsor of the Defend Our Coast Act, which will protect the coasts of North Carolina from being leased for exploration, development, and production of oil or gas. I also cosponsored the Arctic Refuge Protection Act, a bill to permanently protect the Coastal Plain of the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge from oil and gas drilling."

"North Carolina’s economy and way of life are rooted in our natural environment. Today, I introduced the Defend Our Coast Act to prevent offshore oil & gas leasing along the mid-Atlantic. We have a responsibility to protect our coastline – now and for the next generation."
Rated 0% by American Energy Alliance

positions.question: Do you generally support gun-control legislation (e.g. red flag laws, boyfriend loopholes)?

evidence.text: "I voted to pass the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act, an historic, commonsense package to reduce the threat of gun violence across the country and protect America’s children and schools."

"This week is Gun Violence Survivors Week - the time of year where gun deaths in the US surpasses gun deaths in peer countries in an entire year. During #GVSurvivorsWeek we must continue to support survivors and work to finally end the epidemic of gun violence."
Rated 0% by Gun Owners of America
Voted in favor of HR 1446 "Enhanced Background Checks Act of 2021."

positions.question: Do you support a government-run (e.g. single-payer) healthcare program, such as Medicare-for-All?

evidence.text: "I am co-leading the Medicaid Saves Lives Act, legislation that will close the coverage gap by providing health insurance to low-income residents of North Carolina and the 11 other states that have refused to expand Medicaid. Over a decade after the passage of the Affordable Care Act, which gave states the opportunity to expand Medicaid, it is time for the federal government to step in to enable low-income people in all states to access health care."

"No one should ever have to decide between life-saving care and paying their household bills, yet many North Carolinians still face this devastating choice every day. That’s why I support creating a comprehensive public option for health insurance, expanding Medicaid in North Carolina, taking steps to reduce the high cost of prescription drugs, and implementing other reforms to ensure affordable and equitable access to care for every American."
"Ten years - that's how long North Carolinians have been waiting for the healthcare they deserve. I'm glad the NC Senate has passed a bill to expand Medicaid and I hope the House follows suit."

positions.question: Do you support expanding paid family AND/OR medical leave benefits (e.g. maternity leave)?

evidence.text: "Americans should never choose between a paycheck and their families – that’s why I am a proud cosponsor of the #FamilyAct, which would create a national paid family leave program."

"Paid sick leave is crucial in the fight against coronavirus. If we want to protect the health of working people and get our economy back on track, Congress needs to ensure that no one has to choose between their health and a paycheck."

"We've come a long way on women's rights, but we have more to do. Republicans in Washington won't stop trying to dictate women's healthcare options, place restrictions on their constitutionally protected right to choose, and limit their personal autonomy. They almost shut down the government in order to defund Planned Parenthood. Rather than turning back the clock on women's health care, Deborah believes we should be focused on making progress on issues like equal pay and paid family leave. Not only do these reforms help women prosper, they would help our families prosper."

positions.question: Should the government be able to regulate the cost of prescription drugs?

evidence.text: "No one should ever have to decide between life-saving care and paying their household bills, yet many North Carolinians still face this devastating choice every day. That’s why I support creating a comprehensive public option for health insurance, expanding Medicaid in North Carolina, taking steps to reduce the high cost of prescription drugs, and implementing other reforms to ensure affordable and equitable access to care for every American."

"One year ago today, the historic Inflation Reduction Act was signed into law. From implementing clean energy tax credits to capping the costs of insulin for Medicare recipients, the IRA has already been delivering for North Carolinians."

"The #AffordableInsulinNow Act caps the cost for insulin at no more than $35/per month ensuring vital and affordable access to this life-saving medication for the millions of Americans living with diabetes. I was proud to vote for this legislation."
Voted in favor of HR 6833 "The Affordable Insulin Now Act"

positions.question: Do you support increasing security along the southern US border?

evidence.text: "Rather than working with Democrats to enact comprehensive immigration reform, Republicans are pushing a partisan package that will separate families at the border. Immigrants make our country stronger, & we need a humane immigration system that reflects that."

"Today, I am at the southwest border with @HouseJudiciary to hear directly from people on the ground about our immigration system. We are committed to pursuing real solutions that will help us create a more humane immigration system while strengthening our economy and security."
"We must work together to address all aspects of our dysfunctional immigration system — dealing with the border while meeting our urgent workforce needs and protecting Dreamers."
Rated 7% by NumbersUSA

positions.question: Do you support requiring immigrants to return to their country of origin before they are eligible for citizenship, regardless of their immigration status?

evidence.text: "I am a proud original cosponsor of the American Dream and Promise Act, a bill that offers protection from deportation and a fair path to citizenship for eligible Dreamers. These talented young people deserve a secure future here in America – the country they love and call home. Crucially, the Dream and Promise Act also creates a path for eligible individuals with Temporary Protected Status (TPS) or Deferred Enforced Departure (DED) to obtain full LPR status and the opportunity to apply for citizenship five years later."

"I am also working to support the guest farmworkers who keep our nation’s agriculture industry strong. Last year, I voted to pass the Farm Workforce Modernization Act, which establishes a program for agricultural workers to earn legal status through continued employment in the agricultural sector. This bipartisan bill will help stabilize our farm workforce and promote fair wages and working conditions for the guest workers who contribute so much to our nation."

"I am committed to defending the Dreamers, undocumented young people brought to this country as children. They attend American schools, work for American companies, and run businesses and raise families in American communities. In short, they are American in every respect except on paper."

"Nothing is more important to me than keeping all families safe and secure. My district is home to a large immigrant population. These students, families, and workers contribute to our communities, our culture, our economy, and our institutions of higher education. In Congress, I am committed to passing comprehensive immigration reform to keep families together, provide a fair pathway to citizenship, and meet our nation’s economic needs."
